summary.text: Nicole A. Williams, a Democrat, represents District 22 (Prince George's County) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Williams was born in Washington, D.C., on September 23, 1977.
Williams earned a B.A. in history and communications from the University of Pittsburgh in 1999 and a J.D. from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law in 2002.
The legislature's biography lists Williams as a partner at Hileman & Williams, P.C., from 2005 to 2014 and as counsel at Rees Broome, P.C., from 2014 to the present.

sources.title: Delegate Nicole A. Williams (Maryland General Assembly)
